plan.supplementDecision: Before paying for the formula shown in a supplement ad, find out whether it discloses the amount of the ingredient the ad emphasized.
plan.persona: U.S. shopper follows an ingredient-forward ad, opens an online label photo, and sees one numbered line for three ingredients. Wants to compare the same ingredient before purchasing.
plan.intent: Interpret a proprietary blend and recover a missing individual amount, if disclosed.
plan.hook: The ad highlights a particular ingredient; the facts panel gives a single amount for the blend.
plan.originalUtility: Written example comparing 600 mg of a blend with a direct 150 mg declaration; a separate bottle/per-serving case and a copy-ready request for the correct version.
plan.narrative: Case-led evidence comparison, with a counterexample and seller-request message.
plan.visualRationale: A single annotated illustrative label line shows the numerical distinction. No brand, seller, official seal, or statement of clinical effect.

language.scope: Indexed discussion excerpt; language signal only.

search.query: how much of each ingredient is in a proprietary blend supplement facts
search.scope: English search oriented to U.S. labels; no verified location or volume.

overlap.difference: E01 covers serving size and comparison across the panel, with a brief blend warning. This page handles the distinct post-ad question of an undisclosed ingredient amount, how rankings in the blend work, and how to request the missing record.
A022 locates and checks studies. A036 starts at a label and verifies the declared amount; it links to A022 for study evaluation.
